landing.featuresDesc: Bizko brings all the important information together in one place — so your prospects find everything at a glance.
landing.featureIdentityDesc: Present who you are and what you do — name, photo, bio and location.
landing.featureServicesDesc: Clearly show what you offer your clients.
landing.featurePricesDesc: Display your rates to attract qualified prospects.
landing.featurePortfolioDesc: Concretely show what you can do with images of your work.
landing.featureContactDesc: Your visitors open WhatsApp with a pre-filled message — no more DMs to ask for a price.
landing.productDesc: Every element of your Bizko is designed to guide your visitor toward contact — without friction.
landing.whatsappDesc: One click is enough to start a real conversation with your next client.
landing.professionsTitle: Your expertise deserves its own space.
landing.professionsDesc: Whether you're a freelancer, creator or consultant, Bizko adapts to your business.
landing.step1Desc: Add your identity, services, prices and portfolio.
landing.step2Desc: Choose your look and your link.
landing.step3Desc: Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, LinkedIn — or wherever your clients find you.
landing.faq1A: Bizko is a professional profile in one link. You present your services, prices, portfolio and WhatsApp — all on a single page to share everywhere.
landing.faq2A: No. Bizko replaces your website for most freelancers. You get a complete pro page in minutes, with no technical skills required.
landing.faq3Q: Can I have my own Bizko link?
landing.faq3A: Yes. Your link will be bizko.me/yourname — easy to share on Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, LinkedIn and everywhere else.
landing.faq4A: Yes. You can add a price to each service. Your prospects see exactly what you offer and how much it costs before contacting you.
landing.faq5Q: How does the WhatsApp button work?
landing.faq5A: When someone clicks the button, WhatsApp opens with a pre-filled message containing the service name and price. All they have to do is send.
landing.faq6Q: Does my profile work on mobile?
landing.faq6A: Yes. Bizko is designed mobile-first. Your profile is perfectly adapted on smartphone, tablet and desktop.
landing.finalTitle: Your next client might already be looking at your profile.
landing.finalDesc: Simply give them a place to discover what you do.

legal.privacyIntro: At Bizko, protecting your personal data is a priority. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and what your rights are.
legal.privacy1: We collect information you provide directly: first name, last name, email address, phone number, city, country, bio, services, pricing, portfolio images, and profile photo. We also collect connection data (IP address, browser type) and profile view statistics.
legal.privacy2: Your data is used to: provide and improve the service, display your public profile, enable contact via WhatsApp, send service-related notifications, ensure account security, and comply with our legal obligations.
legal.privacy3: We do not sell your personal data. We may share it with: our technical providers (hosting, database), competent authorities in case of legal obligation, and third-party services you voluntarily connect (Google OAuth).
legal.privacy4: Your data is stored on secure servers (Supabase/Amazon Web Services). We use HTTPS encryption, secure authentication, and strict access policies to protect your information.
legal.privacy5: Bizko uses essential cookies for service operation (authentication, language preferences). We do not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies.
legal.privacy6: In accordance with GDPR and applicable laws, you have the following rights: right to access your data, right to rectification, right to erasure (account deletion), right to data portability, and right to object to processing.
legal.privacy7: Your data is retained as long as your account is active. After account deletion, data is permanently deleted within 30 days.
legal.privacy8: Your data may be transferred to countries outside your country of residence. We ensure that these transfers comply with applicable regulations.
legal.privacy9: We reserve the right to modify this policy at any time. Modifications are notified by email or via the service. Continued use after modification constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
legal.privacy10: For any questions regarding this policy or to exercise your rights, contact us at support@bizko.me.
